nodes.scope: Latest strict output instructions for latent/conscious roles, schema conformance and inherited ADR0053 guidance correction. Does not establish live completion or current freeze condition.
Pure prose strict intent renderer and schema-validated examples only. Old version-pinned prompt execution superseded by ADR0056; physical observer/lifecycle separately sealed, not included here.

Authorized bounded correction section and local shape verification only: retain schema/state/source semantics and policy cap, compact full example, no item-count cap or copied example world facts. Historical stage/root-cause/public facts are observations, not refreshed live proof.
Schema-validated examples and role-specific strict object/source instructions, distinctions between legal option data and returned intents. No input compression or final assembled prompt claim.

Compact whole-output examples retain feelings/tendencies/reflex/affective sources and side/tick identity; prose requests brevity within supplied budget without new state item cap. No guaranteed real output size claim.

Three local tests: every supported action kind schema-valid, string/copied-option intents rejected, latent ambiguity and conscious thought/source separation explained. No final request transmission or model adherence claim.

Two local tests: complete compact example accepted over successive ticks with both sources/current identity; rendered budget carries intact schema-valid JSON without state item-count cap. No real token reduction/model adherence claim.

clauses: ADR0056: latest latent/conscious output instructions and strict schema
Inherited response repair: option data differs from action intent
Bounded latent truncation correction: compact full output example without losing meanings or item-count cap
limitations: No live provider or guaranteed output size
Helper renderers only; assembled request tests remain required
Compression policy successor is not implemented or certified by these helper tests
